explication: Kubernetes manages containerized workloads through a control-plane API: users submit desired state, the API server authenticates/admission-checks and persists resources, controllers reconcile them, the scheduler assigns Pods, and kubelets run them on nodes. The tree also identifies networking, cluster bootstrap, and resource-version migration capabilities. Storage-provider wiring is shown where sampled source establishes it; broader controller and node interactions are summarized from the product structure and README-level description, not inspected implementation.
